title: A package with two stories
concept: How the design map names parts and how the parts reference each other.

annotations.note: StoryList enumerates this document's stories by id; idPkg references point at the part files.
Each idPkg:Spread / idPkg:Story / idPkg:MasterSpread names another part by its src path.
Two stories are declared; the spread's two text frames each point at one via ParentStory.
